integrity: A self-contained operator-norm proof and exact unitary witness; finite computations are only supplementary. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact norms are established only for the specified real-linear quaternionic row map; this is not a classification of all preservers. A previously unlocated equivalent quaternionic operator-space formulation could affect novelty.
title: A sharp two-level amplification obstruction for a real-linear unitary preserver
